body:
🛡️ Border Guard

Border Guard adds magical protectors that guard structures. Only players with a special key can pass. Sneak past them, claim the key, or destroy the protectors with the rare Protector Killer.

📦 What This Datapack Adds

This datapack adds a structure containing three special items:

🪄 Protector Staff
Summons magical protectors that block anyone without a key.

🗝️ Border Key
Allows players to safely pass through protectors.

⚔️ Protector Killer
Destroys protectors instantly.
🧭 How It Works

Find the Border Guard tower structure in your world

Loot the special items inside

Use the Protector Staff to summon protectors

Only players with a Border Key can pass

Use the Protector Killer to remove protectors
🌍 Perfect For

• SMP servers
• Protecting bases
• Dungeon-style structures
• Multiplayer challenges
⚙️ Installation

Download the datapack

Place it in your world's
datapacks
folder

Run
/reload
or restart the world
